rubrics.title: Model Quality & Information Review Rubric
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: The output is usable and technically coherent, evidence supports findings, and no critical QA/QC issue is left unexplained.

criteria.title: Model Structure & Information
criteria.description: Reviews structure, naming, levels/grids, parameters, and information completeness.

criteria.title: Accuracy & Consistency
criteria.description: Identifies material inconsistencies and supports conclusions with evidence.

criteria.title: QA/QC Method
criteria.description: Uses a systematic, reproducible review method and severity logic.

criteria.title: Findings & Technical Reasoning
criteria.description: Prioritizes findings and proposes defensible corrective action.

criteria.title: Documentation Quality
criteria.description: Produces clear, traceable, and reviewable report/checklist evidence.

rubrics.title: Federated Coordination & Clash Review Rubric
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: Federation assumptions are explicit, significant issues are correctly classified and traceable, and coordination actions are usable.

criteria.title: Federation & Setup
criteria.description: Verifies discipline scope, coordinates, units, alignment, and test assumptions.

criteria.title: Clash Identification
criteria.description: Finds material coordination issues without relying on unfiltered clash counts.

criteria.title: Issue Classification
criteria.description: Groups, prioritizes, and assigns meaningful issue categories.

criteria.title: Coordination Reasoning
criteria.description: Proposes ownership, actions, and recheck logic with technical justification.

criteria.title: Report & Traceability
criteria.description: Maintains clear links between issue log, screenshots, status, and recommendations.

rubrics.title: 4D Model-Schedule Linkage Rubric
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: WBS interpretation, grouping, mapping, and sequence reasoning are coherent and supported by traceable derived evidence.

criteria.title: WBS & Activity Understanding
criteria.description: Interprets IDs, dates, dependencies, scope, and activity intent correctly.

criteria.title: Model Breakdown
criteria.description: Defines usable selection/grouping logic aligned with construction scope.

criteria.title: Model-Schedule Mapping
criteria.description: Creates complete and traceable links between model groups and activities.

criteria.title: Sequence Logic
criteria.description: Evaluates sequence states and identifies meaningful linkage/data issues.

criteria.title: Documentation
criteria.description: Explains assumptions, problems, corrections, and sequence evidence clearly.

rubrics.title: QTO / 5D Validation Rubric
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: The extraction and reconciliation are reproducible, discrepancies are reasoned, and no critical reliability concern is unresolved.

criteria.title: Model Readiness
criteria.description: Checks scope, categories, units, classification, and parameter suitability.

criteria.title: Quantity Extraction
criteria.description: Produces a controlled and reproducible quantity extract.

criteria.title: Validation Method
criteria.description: Uses an appropriate comparison and reconciliation method.

criteria.title: Discrepancy Analysis
criteria.description: Explains differences, assumptions, and material reliability risks.

criteria.title: Documentation
criteria.description: Presents methodology, tables, evidence, and limitations clearly.

rubrics.title: Automation / Digital Workflow Improvement Rubric
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: If undertaken, the improvement is useful, validated against a baseline, and explicit about errors, limits, and safe use.

criteria.title: Problem Definition
criteria.description: Defines a material repetitive problem, users, inputs, and baseline.

criteria.title: Workflow Logic
criteria.description: Presents coherent transformation/automation logic and controls.

criteria.title: Functional Result
criteria.description: Demonstrates a usable output through safe derived evidence.

criteria.title: Validation & Limitations
criteria.description: Compares output with baseline and documents failure modes and limits.

criteria.title: Practical Benefit & Documentation
criteria.description: Explains measurable benefit, safe use, and next actions clearly.

rubrics.title: BIM Documentation / Delivery Package Rubric
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: The package is structured, consistent, traceable, and clear about status, revisions, issues, and handover assumptions.

criteria.title: Deliverable Structure
criteria.description: Organizes scope, register fields, files, and status coherently.

criteria.title: Naming & Status Control
criteria.description: Applies clear naming, suitability/status, and information-authority logic.

criteria.title: Revision & Issue Traceability
criteria.description: Maintains traceable revisions, issue states, decisions, and open actions.

criteria.title: Information Consistency
criteria.description: Checks consistency across derived model reports, drawings, and registers.

criteria.title: Handover & Communication Quality
criteria.description: Communicates assumptions, limitations, responsibilities, and handover status clearly.
